Cryogenic Example Coating (KSC-TOPS-901)
Keeping Propellant Cold with an Example Coating
Overview
Thermal coatings for cryogenic tanks reflect sunlight & keep propellant cold.
The Technology
The coating scatters sunlight from the UV to the mid-IR. It's sprayed on or applied as tiles.
Benefits
  • Reflects nearly all sunlight
  • Flexible and moisture resistant
Applications
  • Propellant depots
  • Lunar surface tanks
